slice.question: Can the continuation semantics needed for the already-materialized r334 cross_field state be reconstructed from current frozen controls plus a bounded constant-size role seed, without fetching any predecessor blob or historical checkpoint?

pass_if: all target continuation projection fields are reproduced
seed is <=512 UTF-8 bytes when minified
no predecessor blob or historical checkpoint is fetched
no richer-mode, protected/manual execution, hosted compute, optional monthly/trial/paid compute quota, or incremental monetary cost is used
falsify_if: a required continuation field is missing or differs
reconstruction requires a protected/manual/richer-mode executor or optional quota-bearing compute

slice.scope_negative: One already-materialized r334 continuation projection only. This does not prove byte-identical LATEST reconstruction, multi-hop persistence, repository-capacity independence, API-rate-limit recovery, SHA-256 substitution, whole-root outcome parity, or Phase-1 completion.

confidence.label: high_for_narrow_reconstruction_property
confidence.uncertainty: The test establishes semantic projection equality only; it does not establish that bounded current-state transport satisfies every end-to-end zero-storage-dependency interpretation.

phase1_constraints.finite_monthly_trial_paid_quota_dependen: NONE CONSUMED IN TESTED PATH; REPOSITORY TRANSPORT/RATE-LIMIT ROBUSTNESS REMAINS AN UNRESOLVED END-TO-END CHILD

frontier: A <=512-byte constant-size seed plus current frozen controls was sufficient to reproduce the tested r334 continuation semantic projection without reading a predecessor blob or historical checkpoint.
The result is intentionally narrow: byte-identical state reconstruction and multi-hop persistence were not tested.
Repository transport/rate-limit robustness and the SHA-256 alternative remain unresolved; no Phase-1 acceptance or completion is claimed.
exact_continuation: Fresh-bootstrap current manifest, RUN_LIFECYCLE, DESIRED_STATE and cross_field config; reconstruct r335 from LATEST. Execute exactly one bounded CLEAN child: test the current-controls-plus-bounded-seed mechanism across one second consecutive own-role transition while forbidding predecessor/history payload fetches, and check whether the same <=512-byte seed schema preserves all required continuation semantics after the transition. Fail closed on any seed growth, missing field, historical payload dependency, richer/protected/manual execution, optional quota-bearing compute, or incremental cost. Preserve API-rate-limit recovery and SHA-256 alternatives; do not start a second leaf.
